definitions.purchase_rows: Quantity > 0, Price > 0, and invoice number does not start with C
definitions.return_rows: Negative-quantity rows whose invoice number does not start with C; kept separate from cancellations.
definitions.cancelled_invoices: Distinct invoice numbers beginning with C.
definitions.repeat_customer: More than one distinct purchase invoice
definitions.at_risk_customer: Relative RFM segment is Needs Attention or At Risk
definitions.segment_method: Relative per-snapshot quintile scores; heuristic labels, not validated business definitions.
definitions.recommendation_priority: Review for current/predicted Needs Attention/At Risk or predicted 90-day inactivity probability >= 0.5; heuristic and not calibrated.
